body:
MIDPOINT REVIEW, reconciled against the current dirty successor tree: the new SaveModel.scala / save-and-deliver.mdx closes my snapshot's missing-sixth-workflow finding. It correctly uses StoryModelCodec, shows Draft decode plus revalidation and a rejected schema, and states that renderer-neutral view compilation is distinct from the still-unimplemented HTML bundle. The five task workflows plus save now give the site a credible answer to “what does this library do?”

Remaining pre-candidate findings:

1. Reproducible producer identity is incomplete. Model and align name exact producer revisions. Represent, summarize, score, and save say only “executed on this documentation branch”; that branch is currently dirty/uncommitted, so a program/output digest binds the files but not the library implementation that produced them. Record the exact storymodel4s revision (or exact archived receipt revision) for each.

2. InterviewScoreFigure.astro still hard-codes the visible resolution, coverage, threshold, event-purity, probe-gain, density, perceptual, and mental-profile strings while deriving bar geometry/data attributes from parsed output. A coherent changed output can therefore move the plot while leaving stale reader-visible numbers. Derive the title/desc and every visible label from parsed data, then court a mutated output through the rendered page, not only through parser attributes.

3. The model-a-story page still has no model-semantic visual. A compact, source-derived, text-twinned context graph of the two sentence-14 records (NarratedWorld versus nested Speech; says versus lacks) would show the library's central “reported content is not root-world fact” contract much more clearly than another numeric chart.

4. Replace “minimum-to-maximum count allowed by that distribution” with the actual support rule: modal-only lower bound versus any-positive-mass upper bound. The current phrase is easy to misread as a statistical interval despite the later disclaimer.

I have not modified or built this shared dirty tree. These are source-level pre-candidate findings; the exact commit and full docs evidence still need formal review after handoff.
